title: fix(plugin-editor): serve Monaco from the Console's own build instead of cdn.jsdelivr.net
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ag3f4YQR9fBKKRFtXe8QcZ)_

Fixes #25899

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The Console's code editors loaded Monaco's core from `cdn.jsdelivr.net` at run time, because nothing in `ui/` ever called `loader.config` and `@monaco-editor/loader` 1.7.0 defaults `paths.vs` to the jsdelivr `monaco-editor@0.55.1` AMD build. Under the Console's CSP (`script-src 'self' 'nonce-…'`, no CDN, no `worker-src`) that script is refused, so every surface fell back to a textarea and the `code-editor` page component stayed on "Loading..." for good.

- **`@object-ui/plugin-editor`**
  - `monaco-editor@^0.55.1` is now a runtime dependency (the maintainer approved it on 2026-10-25, option A, self-host).
  - New `bundledMonaco.ts` with `configureBundledMonaco(loader)`. It imports `monaco-editor` as a lazy ESM chunk and calls `loader.config({ monaco })` before the first `loader.init()`. A loader that already holds an instance resolves `init()` with it and injects no script.
  - `self.MonacoEnvironment.getWorker` imports each language worker through Vite's `?worker` the first time Monaco asks for that label (json, css/scss/less, html/handlebars/razor, typescript/javascript, and the editor worker for the rest). Each worker starts from a same-origin file under `assets/`.
  - `MonacoImpl` mounts `<Editor>` only once that config has landed. When the editor chunk cannot be fetched, it edits the same text in a plain textarea (read-only kept) and warns once, instead of loading forever.
  - A failed import clears the cached promise, so the next caller tries again.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**
  - `useMonacoFallback`'s one loader probe per page now awaits `configureBundledMonaco` (through a dynamic `import('@object-ui/plugin-editor')`, because the probe sits in the eager closure) before `loader.init()`.
  - The JSON source tab, the html / react page source editor and the metadata form's `CodeWidget` all mount through that probe, so all of them get the bundled Monaco. The plain-textarea fallback stays for a chunk that cannot be fetched, and the report now names the chunk URL the browser could not fetch.
  - Comments that said "CDN" now describe the lazy chunk.
- No change to `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`: Vite's default `?worker` output already emits same-origin worker files, so no worker output config was needed.

## Bundle size (console `vite build`, before = `d5f4c2a2`, after = this branch)

| Measurement | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `du -sh dist/assets` | 54M (45,554,410 B) | 73M (65,018,497 B) |
| All JS, raw | 30,547,408 B | 44,096,511 B (+13,549,103) |
| First-paint closure (`eager-closure.json`) | 85 chunks, 6,739,969 B raw / 1,976,242 B gz | 85 chunks, 6,740,072 B raw (+103) / 1,976,272 B gz (+30) |
| Entry chunk | 310,652 B | 310,652 B (unchanged) |

No Monaco, editor or worker chunk is in the first-paint closure. The added bytes are lazy files loaded only on a screen that opens an editor:

| File | Raw | Gzip |
|---|---|---|
| editor.api2 (Monaco core) | 3,622,381 B | 913,125 B |
| ts.worker | 6,904,380 B | 1,477,433 B |
| css.worker | 1,054,840 B | 238,629 B |
| html.worker | about 720 KB | |
| json.worker | about 410 KB | |
| editor.worker | 280,410 B | 85,786 B |

`codicon.ttf` is also added.

## Browser smoke under the Console CSP

Setup:
- `os` showcase backend serving this branch's console build, with `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false`.
- The response carried the strict CSP: no `unsafe-eval`, no CDN in `script-src`, no `worker-src`.
- Playwright Chromium; 827 requests in total.

| Surface | Route | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `CodeWidget` (metadata form code field) | hook `showcase_normalize_task_title` | Monaco mounted |
| `JsonSourceEditor` (Source tab) | object `showcase_task` | Monaco, 34 lines rendered |
| `SourcePageEditor` | html page `showcase_start_here` | 2 Monaco editors, 54 lines |

- **CSP:** 0 `securitypolicyviolation` events (script-src or worker-src).
- **CDN:** 0 requests to `cdn.jsdelivr.net`.
- **Failures:** 0 failed requests.
- **Workers:** `ts.worker-*.js` and `editor.worker-*.js` loaded from `/_console/assets/` (same origin).
- **Not separately smoked:** the `code-editor` page component. It renders the same `MonacoImpl` that the tests below cover.

## Tests

**New tests in `ui/packages/plugin-editor`:**
- `bundledMonaco.noCdn.test.tsx`. Uses the real `@monaco-editor/loader` and the real `MonacoImpl`.
  - `<Editor>` mounts only after the loader holds the bundled Monaco.
  - `loader.init()` answers with it, and no jsdelivr or `vs/loader.js` script is appended.
  - `getWorker` maps each label to its worker module.
- `MonacoImpl.chunkFailure.test.tsx`. Importing `monaco-editor` rejects, which covers card bullet 3.
  - An editable textarea holds the value and `onChange` fires.
  - Read-only is kept.
  - Exactly one warning.

**Reverse verification**, run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation landed as an on-disk blob change and was restored to an empty `git diff HEAD`:
- Dropping `loader.config(...)` from `configureBundledMonaco` turns noCdn red: "the loader held the bundled Monaco when Editor mounted: expected false to be true".
- Disabling the `unavailable` branch in `MonacoImpl` turns both chunkFailure tests red: "Unable to find a label with the text of: javascript source".

**app-shell suites:**
- 16 existing app-shell suites that mock `@monaco-editor/react` now also stub `configureBundledMonaco`.
- `useMonacoFallback.loaderRejection-11800` and `CodeWidget.loaderFallback-11858` now fail the chunk import itself. They assert that the report names the chunk URL and that no loader script is ever appended.

**Results at `32c20ded`:**
- Monaco-related set (21 files): 907/907 passed.
- Full `packages/app-shell/` + `packages/plugin-editor/` run from the ui root: 1724 test files passed, 1 skipped (1725); 15880 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- plugin-editor build and type-check, app-shell type-check: pass.
- eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.

**Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reports 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first stopped on missing build output: the console `plugin.d.ts`, and seven backend packages with no `dist/`. Both passed after building those outputs.

## Acceptance notes

- **Outside the claimed file surface.** Three suites under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` got the same one-line `configureBundledMonaco` stub: `InterfacesPillar.sourcePage-12522`, `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesCreatePage-11823` and `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesReadOnly-11136`.
  - They render the same Monaco surfaces and broke the same way as the claimed metadata-admin suites.
  - This is a bounded in-place fix of the same defect class, with no new verification surface.
- **Out of scope: the `ui/apps/site` playground** (`apps/site/app/playground/page.tsx`) still loads Monaco from the CDN.
- **Stale comment, not edited:** the CSP doc comment in `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`, near `consoleContentSecurityPolicy`. It still says Monaco loads its core from jsdelivr and shows its plain-text fallback. That file is outside this card's surface.
- **jsdelivr string still shipped:** the URL survives in `@monaco-editor/loader`'s default config inside an eager chunk. It is never requested once `loader.config({ monaco })` has run, and the smoke above shows zero requests to it.
- **React page tier:** the smoke ran with the react page tier off. With it on, the CSP adds only `'unsafe-eval'`, which does not affect where scripts or workers may load from.
- **Other bundlers:** a host bundling `@object-ui/plugin-editor` with something other than Vite must resolve the `?worker` imports itself (noted in the changeset).
